description: Create (or replace) the signing secret for this brand's generic alert webhook and return it ONCE — it is never readable again, so hand it to the user to store. Every event carries Standard Webhooks headers: webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature = v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "id.timestamp.body"> keyed by the base64 part after whsec_. On a rotation the OLD secret keeps signing alongside the new one for 24 hours (two signatures in the header), so a receiver being updated never rejects an event. Free.
name: rotate_webhook_signing_secret
title: Rotate the webhook signing secret
